seed: A line and an arrow have always ended in a half circle, with nothing anywhere to say otherwise, so a line drawing built out of the shape tools could never be made to match one drawn with the Pen. The walk draws a line, finds Ends under Outline beside its Thickness, switches it between flat, round and square, checks one undo puts it back, does the same to an arrow's tail, and confirms a box is not asked a question it cannot answer.

steps.note: THE TEST: a line you drew is asked what its ends look like, under Outline right beside its Thickness. Before this the row was not there at all and a line ended in a half circle whatever anybody wanted.
turned up to 24 so the difference between the three answers is something you can see across the room. This is the half circle it has always drawn.
THE TEST: the line stops dead on the point it was dragged to. Compare its two ends with 2-thick-round.
THE TEST: a half square past the last point, so the line reaches as far as the round one did and keeps its corners. Nothing is sliced off at the frame edge.
one undo, one step back: square becomes flat again rather than the whole line disappearing
THE TEST: an arrow is asked the same question and the answer reaches its TAIL. The head is its own part with its own settings and is untouched.
THE TEST: a box is closed and has no ends anybody can see, so it is not asked. The panel's own rule: a control that cannot act is not shown.
